design: popup shell: opener detached first, CSP meta (default-src 'none'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; img-src data:; font-src data:; frame-src about:) second, a hidden allow-same-origin measuring frame (no scripts) reads the content height at the fixed 700 px frame width, then an empty-sandbox printed frame sized to that height + 2 px is inserted with srcdoc already set and print() runs on its content load; result.html is never document.write-n
instrumentation: observe-only wrappers on window.open (main page), Document.prototype.write and window.print (all pages) record then call the native original; no popup, handle or print result is fabricated; headless native print() opens no dialog. Mutation cases add test-only init scripts that strip sandbox and CSP, or force a 100vh frame height.
outputExtraction: popup.pdf(format A4, print media) written to an OS temp directory and read with pdftotext -layout (poppler); file removed after reading; page count = form feeds; markers are unique ROWTOKEN001/040/080/120 and an end marker
payload: harmless synthetic script plus passive img and stylesheet references: reads and mutates uniquely named localStorage and non-HttpOnly cookie sentinels, tries parent and window.top.opener access, fetches, loads an image and a stylesheet from one intercepted no-forward same-origin endpoint; only booleans and counts are recorded, no cookie or storage values
